data.title: Cavalli Tower
data.about:
Cavalli Tower by DAMAC rises majestically in the prestigious Al Sufouh area, offering a distinctive blend of architectural elegance and beachfront serenity. This iconic 70-storey tower showcases an exclusive selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside luxurious 3 and 4-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is crafted to the highest standards, combining contemporary design with sophisticated interiors.

Developed by DAMAC Properties and envisioned by acclaimed architect Shaun Killa, Cavalli Tower features a selection of exceptional lifestyle amenities, including sky-high pools and fine dining venues. Select apartments come equipped with private pools or Jacuzzis, offering an elevated living experience. This project represents a seamless integration of luxury, location, and lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Cavalli Tower by DAMAC – Exceptional Living with Iconic Views and Unmatched Design
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in Al Sufouh - Situated minutes from the city’s key business and leisure districts.
  • Architectural Landmark by Shaun Killa - Created by the visionary behind the Museum of the Future.
  • Uninterrupted Sea and City Views - Enjoy stunning panoramas of Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, and Dubai Marina.
  • Private Pools in Select Units - Choose residences with exclusive pools or Jacuzzis.
  • Direct Beach Access - Private pedestrian bridge links to Westin Mina Seyahi beach.
  • Elevated Living Experience - Features include a beach pool, indoor waterfall, and sky pool.
  • Fine Dining Within Reach - On-site gourmet restaurants offer a premier culinary experience.
  • Backed by DAMAC's Legacy - A project by one of Dubai’s leading luxury developers.

location_tile.title: Located along the western coast of Dubai, Al Sufouh is a high-profile neighbourhood in Jumeirah.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Cavalli Tower in Al Sufouh enjoys an enviable position close to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), providing seamless connectivity to Dubai's commercial, leisure, and shopping hubs. This locale balances urban accessibility with a coastal ambiance, making it a strategic choice for refined living.

  • 7 Minutes – Dubai Marina Mall
  • 9 Minutes – Palm Jumeirah
  • 10 Minutes – JBR
  • 10 Minutes – Mall of Emirates
  • 18 Minutes – Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa
  • 22 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
